lamps.steady: Driver or passenger seat belt is unfastened. Fasten the seat belt.
lamps.flashing: Seat belt is unfastened while driving 20 km/h or faster. Fasten the seat belt.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in the supplemental restraint system (SRS). Have system checked by an authorised Kia dealer.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction in the SRS system when ignition switch is ON. Have system checked.

lamps.lamp: Parking brake & brake fluid warning light
lamps.steady: Parking brake applied or brake fluid level is low. Stop safely, check fluid level, or tow vehicle.
Malfunction with the ABS system. Normal braking remains operational; have vehicle inspected.

lamps.lamp: Motor Driven Power Steering (MDPS) warning light
lamps.steady: Malfunction with power steering system. Move to safe zone and have system inspected.
lamps.flashing: Abnormality detected in MDPS system and steering assist is stopped. Check immediately.

lamps.steady: Malfunction with alternator or electrical charging system. Stop safely, check drive belt, and get vehicle inspected.
Malfunction with emission control system, engine, or powertrain. Have vehicle inspected.
lamps.flashing: In diesel engine, injection quantity error or DPF issue causing engine power loss. Drive to clear or inspect.

lamps.steady: Engine oil pressure is low. Stop safely, turn off engine, check oil level, and add oil if needed.
Water has accumulated inside the diesel fuel filter. Drain water from the fuel filter immediately.
Fuel tank is nearly empty. Refill fuel as soon as possible.

lamps.lamp: Low tyre pressure warning light / TPMS malfunction indicator
lamps.steady: One or more tyres are significantly underinflated. Stop safely and adjust inflation pressure.
lamps.flashing: Flashes for 60 seconds then remains steady when TPMS has a malfunction. Have system inspected.

lamps.steady: Indicates lamp failure, LED headlamp error, or driver assistance sensor issue. Check LCD display details.

lamps.lamp: Exhaust system (DPF or LNT) warning light
lamps.steady: DPF/LNT malfunction or soot accumulated. Drive above 60 km/h or gear 2+ at 1,500-2,500 RPM to regenerate.
lamps.flashing: DPF regeneration required or system error. Have DPF system checked by a professional workshop.

lamps.steady: PPF soot accumulation or system malfunction. Drive over 80 km/h in 3rd gear or higher for 30 minutes.
lamps.flashing: PPF system error persists. Have the PPF system inspected by a professional workshop.

lamps.steady: Urea solution tank is nearly empty. Refill urea solution as soon as possible.
Malfunction with the LED headlamp. Have vehicle inspected by a professional workshop.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction with an LED headlamp related component. Have vehicle inspected by a professional workshop.

lamps.steady: ESC system malfunction detected. Have vehicle inspected by a professional workshop.
lamps.flashing: ESC system is actively operating while driving.

lamps.lamp: Electronic stability control (ESC) OFF indicator light
lamps.steady: ESC system is turned off by pressing the ESC OFF button.
Engine has entered Idle Stop mode of the ISG system.
lamps.flashing: Automatic engine restarting is occurring (blinks for 5 seconds).

lamps.steady: Key with immobiliser is detected properly; engine can be started.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction with immobiliser system. Have vehicle inspected by a professional workshop.

lamps.steady: Smart key detected in vehicle properly or undetected key warning. Inspect if engine will not start.
lamps.flashing: Smart key not in vehicle, battery weak, or immobiliser malfunction detected.

lamps.steady: System malfunction if light remains steady without blinking. Have vehicle inspected.
lamps.flashing: Turn signal or hazard switch activated. Rapid blinking indicates bulb/system malfunction.

lamps.steady: Headlights are turned on.
Headlights are switched to high beam or flash-to-pass is active.
Tail lights or headlights are switched on.
Front fog lights are turned on.
Engine is preheating. Wait until light turns off before starting engine.
lamps.flashing: Engine preheating system malfunction if blinking while driving. Have vehicle inspected.

lamps.steady: Cruise control system is enabled.
Cruise control cruising speed is set.
A door is not securely closed. Close all doors properly.
Tailgate is not securely closed. Close tailgate properly.
Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist system malfunctioned or front camera is obscured. Clean glass or inspect.
Lane Keeping Assist system malfunctioned or front view camera is blocked. Clean windscreen or inspect.
System enabled and assisting steering (green) or in standby (grey).
lamps.flashing: Steering wheel is not assisted (blinks white before turning grey).
